verses.original: δὲ ἀδελφοί Γνωρίζομεν ὑμῖν τὴν χάριν τοῦ Θεοῦ τὴν δεδομένην ἐν ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις τῆς Μακεδονίας
verses.transliteration: de adelphoi Gnōrizomen hymin tēn charin tou Theou tēn dedomenēn en tais ekklēsiais tēs Makedonias
verses.literal: Now brothers we want you to know about . . . the grace [that] - God - has given . . . the churches - of Macedonia

verses.original: ὅτι ἐν πολλῇ δοκιμῇ θλίψεως ἡ τῆς αὐτῶν περισσεία χαρᾶς καὶ ἡ βάθους κατὰ αὐτῶν πτωχεία ἐπερίσσευσεν εἰς τὸ πλοῦτος τῆς ἁπλότητος αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: hoti en pollē dokimē thlipseōs hē tēs autōn perisseia charas kai hē bathous kata autōn ptōcheia eperisseusen eis to ploutos tēs haplotētos autōn
verses.literal: - In [the] terrible ordeal they suffered - - their abundant joy and - deep - - poverty overflowed into - rich - generosity -

verses.original: ὅτι μαρτυρῶ κατὰ δύναμιν καὶ παρὰ δύναμιν αὐθαίρετοι
verses.transliteration: hoti martyrō kata dynamin kai para dynamin authairetoi
verses.literal: For I testify [that] [they gave] according to [their] ability and even beyond [it] Of their own accord

verses.original: μετὰ πολλῆς παρακλήσεως δεόμενοι ἡμῶν τὴν χάριν καὶ τὴν κοινωνίαν τῆς διακονίας τῆς εἰς τοὺς ἁγίους
verses.transliteration: meta pollēs paraklēseōs deomenoi hēmōn tēn charin kai tēn koinōnian tēs diakonias tēs eis tous hagious
verses.literal: vvv vvv they earnestly pleaded with us for the privilege - - of sharing in [this] service - to the saints

verses.original: καὶ οὐ καθὼς ἠλπίσαμεν ἀλλ’ ἔδωκαν ἑαυτοὺς πρῶτον τῷ Κυρίῳ καὶ ἡμῖν διὰ θελήματος Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai ou kathōs ēlpisamen all’ edōkan heautous prōton tō Kyriō kai hēmin dia thelēmatos Theou
verses.literal: And not [only] [did they do] as we expected but they gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us through [the] will of God

verses.original: Εἰς ἡμᾶς τὸ παρακαλέσαι Τίτον ἵνα οὕτως καὶ ἐπιτελέσῃ ταύτην εἰς ὑμᾶς καὶ τὴν χάριν καθὼς προενήρξατο
verses.transliteration: Eis hēmas to parakalesai Titon hina houtōs kai epitelesē tautēn eis hymas kai tēn charin kathōs proenērxato
verses.literal: So we - urged Titus - - vvv to help complete - vvv your - [act of] grace just as he had started [it]

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ὥσπερ περισσεύετε ἐν παντὶ πίστει καὶ λόγῳ καὶ γνώσει καὶ πάσῃ σπουδῇ καὶ τῇ ἀγάπῃ ἡμῶν ἐξ ἐν ὑμῖν ἵνα περισσεύητε καὶ ἐν ταύτῃ τῇ χάριτι
verses.transliteration: all’ hōsper perisseuete en panti pistei kai logō kai gnōsei kai pasē spoudē kai tē agapē hēmōn ex en hymin hina perisseuēte kai en tautē tē chariti
verses.literal: But just as you excel in everything in faith - in speech - in knowledge in complete earnestness and in the love we [inspired] in you [see] that you also excel . . . in this - grace of giving

verses.original: Οὐ λέγω κατ’ ἐπιταγὴν ἀλλὰ δοκιμάζων τὸ γνήσιον ὑμετέρας τῆς ἀγάπης διὰ τῆς σπουδῆς ἑτέρων καὶ
verses.transliteration: Ou legō kat’ epitagēn alla dokimazōn to gnēsion hymeteras tēs agapēs dia tēs spoudēs heterōn kai
verses.literal: vvv I am not giving - a command but I am testing the sincerity of your - love through the earnestness of others -

verses.original: γὰρ Γινώσκετε τὴν χάριν ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ὅτι ὤν πλούσιος δι’ ὑμᾶς ἐπτώχευσεν ἵνα ὑμεῖς τῇ ἐκείνου πτωχείᾳ πλουτήσητε
verses.transliteration: gar Ginōskete tēn charin hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou hoti ōn plousios di’ hymas eptōcheusen hina hymeis tē ekeinou ptōcheia ploutēsēte
verses.literal: For you know the grace of our - Lord Jesus Christ that [though] He was rich yet for your sake . . . He became poor so that you - through [His] poverty might become rich

verses.original: καὶ τοῦτο δίδωμι γνώμην γὰρ συμφέρει ὑμῖν ἐν τούτῳ ἀπὸ πέρυσι οἵτινες προενήρξασθε οὐ μόνον τὸ ποιῆσαι ἀλλὰ καὶ τὸ θέλειν
verses.transliteration: kai touto didōmi gnōmēn gar sympherei hymin en toutō apo perysi hoitines proenērxasthe ou monon to poiēsai alla kai to thelein
verses.literal: And this is my opinion . . . about what is helpful for you in this [matter] vvv Last year [you were] the first not only - to [give] but even - to have such a desire

verses.original: νυνὶ δὲ καὶ ἐπιτελέσατε τὸ ποιῆσαι ὅπως τὸ ἐπιτελέσαι καθάπερ ἡ προθυμία τοῦ θέλειν οὕτως καὶ ἐκ τοῦ ἔχειν
verses.transliteration: nyni de kai epitelesate to poiēsai hopōs to epitelesai kathaper hē prothymia tou thelein houtōs kai ek tou echein
verses.literal: Now . . . . . . finish - the work so that - you may complete it with the same - eager - desire . . . . . . according to [your] means

verses.original: γὰρ εἰ ἡ προθυμία πρόκειται εὐπρόσδεκτος καθὸ ἐὰν ἔχῃ οὐ καθὸ οὐκ ἔχει
verses.transliteration: gar ei hē prothymia prokeitai euprosdektos katho ean echē ou katho ouk echei
verses.literal: For if the eagerness is there [the gift] is acceptable according to what one has not according to vvv [what] he does not have

verses.original: γὰρ Οὐ ἵνα ἄλλοις ἄνεσις ὑμῖν θλῖψις ἀλλ’ ἐξ ἰσότητος
verses.transliteration: gar Ou hina allois anesis hymin thlipsis all’ ex isotētos
verses.literal: [It is not our intention] . . . that others may be relieved while you are burdened but [that there may be] equality

verses.original: ἐν τῷ νῦν καιρῷ ὑμῶν τὸ περίσσευμα εἰς ἐκείνων τὸ ὑστέρημα ἵνα καὶ ἐκείνων τὸ περίσσευμα γένηται εἰς ὑμῶν τὸ ὑστέρημα ὅπως γένηται ἰσότης
verses.transliteration: en tō nyn kairō hymōn to perisseuma eis ekeinōn to hysterēma hina kai ekeinōn to perisseuma genētai eis hymōn to hysterēma hopōs genētai isotēs
verses.literal: At the present time your - surplus will meet their - need so that in turn their - surplus will meet your - need This way there will be equality

verses.original: καθὼς γέγραπται Ὁ τὸ πολὺ οὐκ ἐπλεόνασεν καὶ ὁ τὸ ὀλίγον οὐκ ἠλαττόνησεν
verses.transliteration: kathōs gegraptai Ho to poly ouk epleonasen kai ho to oligon ouk ēlattonēsen
verses.literal: As it is written He who [gathered] - much vvv had no excess and he who [gathered] - little vvv had no shortfall

verses.original: δὲ Χάρις τῷ Θεῷ τῷ διδόντι ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ Τίτου τὴν αὐτὴν σπουδὴν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: de Charis tō Theō tō didonti en tē kardia Titou tēn autēn spoudēn hyper hymōn
verses.literal: But thanks [be] - to God who put into the heart of Titus the same devotion [I have] for you

verses.original: ὅτι μὲν ἐδέξατο τὴν παράκλησιν δὲ ὑπάρχων σπουδαιότερος ἐξῆλθεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς αὐθαίρετος
verses.transliteration: hoti men edexato tēn paraklēsin de hyparchōn spoudaioteros exēlthen pros hymas authairetos
verses.literal: For not only did he welcome [our] appeal but he {is} eagerly coming to you of his own volition

verses.original: μετ’ αὐτοῦ δὲ Συνεπέμψαμεν τὸν ἀδελφὸν οὗ ὁ ἔπαινος διὰ πασῶν τῶν ἐκκλησιῶν ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ
verses.transliteration: met’ autou de Synepempsamen ton adelphon hou ho epainos dia pasōn tōn ekklēsiōn en tō euangeliō
verses.literal: Along with [Titus] - we are sending the brother who - is praised by all the churches [for his work] in the gospel

verses.original: καὶ δὲ οὐ μόνον ἀλλὰ χειροτονηθεὶς ὑπὸ τῶν ἐκκλησιῶν συνέκδημος ἡμῶν σὺν ταύτῃ τῇ χάριτι τῇ ὑφ’ ἡμῶν διακονουμένῃ πρὸς τὴν δόξαν τοῦ Κυρίου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡμῶν προθυμίαν
verses.transliteration: kai de ou monon alla cheirotonētheis hypo tōn ekklēsiōn synekdēmos hēmōn syn tautē tē chariti tē hyph’ hēmōn diakonoumenē pros tēn doxan tou Kyriou autou kai hēmōn prothymian
verses.literal: More than that . . . . . . . . . . . . [this brother] was chosen by the churches to accompany us with - the gracious offering - - we administer to - honor the Lord Himself and [to show] our eagerness [to help]

verses.original: στελλόμενοι τοῦτο μή τις μωμήσηται ἡμᾶς ἐν τῇ ὑφ’ ἡμῶν διακονουμένῃ ταύτῃ τῇ ἁδρότητι
verses.transliteration: stellomenoi touto mē tis mōmēsētai hēmas en tē hyph’ hēmōn diakonoumenē tautē tē hadrotēti
verses.literal: We [want to] avoid - - any criticism - of - [the way] we administer this - generous [ gift ]

verses.original: γὰρ προνοοῦμεν καλὰ οὐ μόνον ἐνώπιον Κυρίου ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐνώπιον ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: gar pronooumen kala ou monon enōpion Kyriou alla kai enōpion anthrōpōn
verses.literal: For we are taking great care to do what is right not only in the eyes of [the] Lord but also in the eyes of men

verses.original: δὲ Συνεπέμψαμεν αὐτοῖς ἡμῶν τὸν ἀδελφὸν ὃν ἐδοκιμάσαμεν σπουδαῖον ὄντα πολλάκις ἐν πολλοῖς δὲ νυνὶ πολὺ πολλῇ σπουδαιότερον πεποιθήσει τῇ εἰς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: de Synepempsamen autois hēmōn ton adelphon hon edokimasamen spoudaion onta pollakis en pollois de nyni poly pollē spoudaioteron pepoithēsei tē eis hymas
verses.literal: And we are sending along with them our - brother who has proven his earnestness [to us] - many times [and] in many ways and now even more [so] by [his] great confidence - in you

verses.original: εἴτε ὑπὲρ Τίτου ἐμὸς κοινωνὸς καὶ συνεργός εἰς ὑμᾶς εἴτε ἡμῶν ἀδελφοὶ ἀπόστολοι ἐκκλησιῶν δόξα Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: eite hyper Titou emos koinōnos kai synergos eis hymas eite hēmōn adelphoi apostoloi ekklēsiōn doxa Christou
verses.literal: As for . . . Titus [he is] my partner and fellow worker among you [As for] our brothers [they are] messengers of [the] churches [the] glory of Christ

verses.original: εἰς πρόσωπον τῶν ἐκκλησιῶν οὖν ἐνδεικνύμενοι εἰς αὐτοὺς τὴν ἔνδειξιν τῆς ὑμῶν ἀγάπης καὶ ἡμῶν καυχήσεως ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: eis prosōpon tōn ekklēsiōn oun endeiknymenoi eis autous tēn endeixin tēs hymōn agapēs kai hēmōn kauchēseōs hyper hymōn
verses.literal: In full view of the churches then show - [these men] the proof of your love and vvv the reason for our boasting about you
